verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items is a fair question for a server-side video API platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents any batch or bulk endpoint, such as acting on many sessions, archives, or streams in one call. Project-wide callbacks for stream activity on all sessions are a monitoring feature, not bulk operations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
